title: Equality of normalized sum distributions
statement: Let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$ and let $n$ be a natural number. The probability measure obtained by taking $n$ independent correlated pairs of signs, mapping each pair to its point in the plane, summing those points, and dividing by $\sqrt n$ equals the distribution of the normalized pair sum when the first sign vector is uniform and each coordinate of the second is kept with probability $(1+\rho)/2$.
